Reading a document back, every UBL 2.1 aggregate component, and the type
declarations caught up with the schema.

Documents built through `Invoice` serialise exactly as they did in 0.1.1 — the
golden fixture is unchanged at 4542 bytes. [MIGRATION.md](../blob/main/MIGRATION.md)
covers what needs action; this is the shape of it.

## Reading a document back

`Invoice.fromXml(xml)` and `Invoice.fromJson(document)` are the inverses of
`getXml()` and `getJson()`.

```ts
const invoice = Invoice.fromXml(receivedXml);
invoice.setDueDate('2026-08-01');
invoice.getXml(false, true);
```

Both rebuild the document from the same tables that write one, so what comes
out renders as what went in: the golden XML fixture round-trips byte for byte,
the JSON fixture renders to the same XML, and an invoice carrying a XAdES
signature keeps it — `ext:ExtensionContent` is `xsd:any`, so its subtree is
carried through rather than interpreted.

An element with no place in the document, or one appearing more often than UBL
allows, throws rather than being dropped.

One caveat if you hash what you re-serialise: an empty element written
`<x></x>` comes back as `<x/>`. That is the serializer, for every element,
however the document was built. MyInvois computes `documentHash` over exact
bytes — hash the bytes you received.

## Every UBL 2.1 aggregate component

The package had 51 of the 109 complex types UBL 2.1 defines, which left 31
child elements with no class to put in them — `cac:Person` on a party,
`cac:CardAccount` on payment means, `cac:Dimension` on an item,
`cac:PaymentTerms` and `cac:PayeeParty` on an invoice.

All 109 are present, written from the schema by `npm run scaffold`.
`npm run report:schema` reports no missing elements for the first time.

Eight invoice children whose setters threw `not implemented` now work, and
seven components that were missing from the `cac` barrel — and therefore
unreachable, since `./cac/<file>` is not an exported subpath — can be imported.

## The declarations now say what UBL says

`AllowedParams` was transcribed by hand and had drifted from the schema in 256
places. Most of that is a relaxation: 193 fields that demanded a value UBL
marks optional no longer do, and `CreditNoteLine` went from requiring 23 fields
to one.

Some of it was not cosmetic. `Delivery.deliveryTerms` was wired to `UdtDate`
for an aggregate and silently emitted an empty element. `UBLExtensions`
discarded whatever its constructor was given. `PaymentTerms` declared
`constructor(content: string)`, so the only call its signature allowed threw.
`PostalAddress` could not take an address line 2 under either spelling.

## Breaking

Four fields became required, 33 became arrays, two became single values, and
eight narrowed to the datatype UBL names. `addressLine` is `addressLines`, and
`Address` and `PostalAddress` are one class rather than two implementations of
`cac:AddressType` that had already drifted apart. `AddressParams` names the
params type rather than the class, which is what it always claimed to be.

Every one is listed in MIGRATION.md with what to change.

## Held to the schema

Four checks run in CI and before publish, and every one of the defects above
was found by building one:

| Check            | Holds                                                                  |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `check:schema`   | element name, sequence position, cardinality → OASIS schemas           |
| `check:types`    | keys, arity, declared type, constructor, barrel export → params map    |
| `check:classref` | classRef → the implementing class; the document map; one file per type |
| `report:schema`  | what is still absent — now nothing                                     |

Structural validation only, not EN 16931: MyInvois deviates from BR-CO-13 by
reporting line-level discounts in `AllowanceTotalAmount` while
`LineExtensionAmount` is already net of them, so business-rule validation
rejects conformant documents.

## Still not implemented

XAdES signing, and the profile constraints MyInvois adds on top of UBL.
